findings.reason: src/constructFrom/index.ts:53 now evaluates `constructFromSymbol in date` for null, since typeof null is "object", so it throws. Direct callers regress: constructNow(null) (src/constructNow/index.ts:36) and roundToNearestMinutes(null, {nearestTo: 0}) (src/roundToNearestMinutes/index.ts:66) used to return a Date and now throw. C1's main trigger is wrong, though. addMilliseconds(null, 1) already threw before this change, inside toDate (src/toDate/index.ts:60 has no null guard). Also, null is not part of the DateArg type. I lowered C1's high to medium because the regression only hits untyped null input on a few paths.
findings.claim: Removing the `date &&` guard means constructFrom(null, value) now throws a TypeError from `constructFromSymbol in null`, where before it returned new Date(value).
findings.evidence: The diff changes `if (date && typeof date === "object" && constructFromSymbol in date)` to `if (typeof date === "object" && constructFromSymbol in date)`. Because `typeof null === "object"`, the `in` operator is evaluated against null, and that throws. Here is one path that triggers it: `addMilliseconds(null, 1)` calls `constructFrom(options?.in || date, +toDate(date) + amount)` (src/addMilliseconds/index.ts:40) with date = null. Before the change that call fell through to `new Date(value)`. The same pattern is in addDays, add, setMonth, isToday and many other functions. Nothing else checks for null before line 53. The guard was not moved anywhere: toDate's own check at src/toDate/index.ts:60 is reached only through toDate, not through constructFrom.

findings.reason: The diff changes only the one line in src/constructFrom/index.ts. A grep for `null` under src/constructFrom finds nothing, so no test covers the changed path. This is a coverage gap, not a separate defect, so I kept it low.
findings.claim: The guard removal ships without a test, and no test checks a null reference date, so the suite cannot catch this change in behaviour.
findings.evidence: The patch is a single one-line change to src/constructFrom/index.ts with no test changes. A grep for `null` in src/constructFrom and src/addMilliseconds finds no test that passes a null date. acceptance.md only says that the baseline tests are the locked tests, and story.md is not in the packet, so nothing on record asks for this behaviour change.
